info.title: AgentOS.NET API
info.description: Versioned REST API of AgentOS.NET. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` — a Keycloak access token (people) or an AgentOS.NET API token `aos_…` (personal tokens and service accounts, created in Settings › API tokens; scopes: read = GET, run = also POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, admin = also tenant-admin routes). The unversioned routes (the same paths without `/v1`) are deprecated and answer with `Deprecation`, `Sunset` and `Link: rel="successor-version"` headers; see https://github.com/hoangsnowy/AgentOS.NET/blob/main/docs/API.md#deprecation-policy.
